details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_inject_token_into_url` (lines 3039-3052) and `_resolve_origin_url` (lines 3074-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Credentials are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using per-command authentication headers.
  WHY: Tokens leak through process arguments, process listings, git diagnostics, persisted `.git/config`, and logs.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` (lines 578-586) and its callers at lines 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed credentials and are passed to git commands as positional arguments.
  WHY: PATs leak through process listings, git diagnostics, runner logs, and remote configuration.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `memory_ensure_branch` (lines 140-180) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Raw git commands replaced the authenticated wrapper while `persist-credentials: false` leaves the origin unauthenticated.
  WHY: Branch discovery and creation fail without ambient credentials, while the assigned token is unused.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `normalize_path` (lines 240-245) and `emit_context` (lines 568-578) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection was removed, allowing targeted context to read credential-bearing files and symlinks to them.
  WHY: Untrusted paths can expose `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/credentials`, and similar secrets to model-visible prompt context.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` (lines 568-578) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Path-count and path-length caps were removed and missing-path markers do not consume the output budget.
  WHY: Thousands of untrusted paths can produce unbounded marker output beyond `max_bytes`, exhausting prompt budget and increasing model cost.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: argument parser (lines 95-112) and hardcoded `base_url` (line 261) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while existing broker callers still pass it.
  WHY: Broker-backed Codex configuration exits with an unknown-argument error before model execution; the hardcoded public base URL also bypasses the loopback broker.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deletion of the entire review-blocked helper block (formerly lines 975-1376) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval, successor, and consumed-marker helpers were deleted while callers still invoke them.
  WHY: Terminal review-blocked approval flows cannot post, detect, verify, or consume approvals.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deletion of `git_with_github_auth` (formerly lines 496-511) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authenticated git helper was removed while judge-fix and reissue branch pushes still call it.
  WHY: Judge fixes fail with `command not found`, and reissue baseline pushes can be silently skipped.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest` projection (lines 766-772) and the GraphQL projection (lines 913-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment JSON lost `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`, and changed its sort tiebreak.
  WHY: Refusal matching, approval authorization, producer binding, downstream consumers, and tests receive an incompatible schema.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` (lines 547-557) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` returns a non-empty disabled block instead of an empty string.
  WHY: Callers cannot disable targeted context as documented and the zero-byte contract test fails.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 59-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup changed from committed-tree detection and staged/worktree restoration to index-only detection and worktree-only restoration.
  WHY: Staged or generated `pre_assembled_static.txt` state can remain inconsistent, leave staged residue, or be committed incorrectly.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-38 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed from `targeted_file_context`.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError` and the targeted-file-context suite cannot run.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: lines 100-102 and lines 111-158, 275, 305 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The test suite still requires the deleted `_memory_git` wrapper and deleted review-blocked helpers.
  WHY: String assertions and subprocess invocations fail, leaving the test file red.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 100 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: A leading tab was introduced on the `local cfg=...` line in an otherwise space-indented function.
  WHY: This violates the repository style contract; no runtime failure was reported.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py: `BrokerPolicy.normalize_request` (lines 60-141) and `model_provider_broker_start` in `scripts/codex_helpers.sh` (lines 164-177) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Broker startup now requires an allowed model, while several callers rely on the unrelated `MODEL_EDITOR` fallback.
  WHY: Those paths fail broker startup when `MODEL_EDITOR` is unset even though they previously succeeded.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest` projection (lines 766-772) and the GraphQL projection (lines 913-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The public comment schema silently dropped fields without an alias or compatibility shim.
  WHY: Shared-library consumers that destructure identity or authorization fields receive missing values, and stable ordering can change.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: These files were not updated in the PR; consumer wrappers continue to receive mutable install-codex@stable; the PR changed files list does not include `.github/workflows/opencode-live-smoke.yml` or any `workflow-templates/ai-*.yml` wrapper.
- requirement: "Validate request JSON and enforce phase-bound model, token, request, and cost limits" - reassert allowed models on every broker prepare/restart
  expected_change_site: scripts/model_provider_broker.py and scripts/codex_helpers.sh prepare call sites
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: Broker startup requires MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_ALLOWED_MODELS but prepare/restart paths do not reassert the allowed-model set.
- requirement: "Fetch the known marker comment by ID or paginate all comments and select the highest verified generation" - verify review_collect_pr_metadata.sh paginates all comments
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh, scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: review_conflict_prepare.sh passes PR_ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE to selector but no assertion verifies that review_collect_pr_metadata.sh collects all pages.
- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line: the re-audit checks sibling code paths (other venues, adapters, handlers, workers) for the same defect and re-opens the loop if any remain."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` (review-blocked helpers), `scripts/targeted_file_context.py` (sensitive-path filter, path cap), `scripts/write_codex_config.sh` (`--provider-base-url`), `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py` (credential handling), `scripts/memory_helpers.sh` (credential handling)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The PR removed the `http.extraHeader` authentication mechanism and replaced it with credential-in-URL, deleted the sensitive-path filter and path cap instead of preserving them, removed `--provider-base-url` without updating 13 callers, and deleted review-blocked helpers without updating 14+ call sites.
